description: This file defines the ConnectionObserver interface for WebRTC streaming in the Cuttlefish project, specifying various event handling methods for device communication and control channels.

classes.name: ConnectionObserver
classes.description: An interface for observing and handling device connection events and messages in WebRTC streaming.

classes.name: ConnectionObserverFactory
classes.description: A factory interface for creating ConnectionObserver instances.

methods.name: OnConnected
methods.description: Called when a connection is established.

methods.name: OnMouseMoveEvent
methods.description: Handles mouse move events with x and y coordinates.

methods.name: OnMouseButtonEvent
methods.description: Handles mouse button press or release events.

methods.name: OnTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch events with device label, position, and down/up state.

methods.name: OnMultiTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles multi-touch events with label, id, x/y positions, and size.

methods.name: OnKeyboardEvent
methods.description: Handles keyboard key press or release events.

methods.name: OnAdbChannelOpen
methods.description: Handles opening of ADB communication channel.

methods.name: OnControlChannelOpen
methods.description: Handles opening of control communication channel.

methods.name: OnCustomActionButton
methods.description: Handles custom action button events with command and button state.

methods.name: OnBluetoothChannelOpen
methods.description: Handles opening of Bluetooth communication channel.

methods.name: OnSensorsChannelOpen
methods.description: Handles opening of sensors communication channel.

methods.name: OnLightsChannelOpen
methods.description: Handles opening of lights communication channel.

methods.name: OnLocationChannelOpen
methods.description: Handles opening of location communication channel.

methods.name: OnKmlLocationsChannelOpen
methods.description: Handles opening of KML locations channel.

methods.name: OnGpxLocationsChannelOpen
methods.description: Handles opening of GPX locations channel.
